caption: The drawing depicts a single brass candlestick holder. The main object is centered within a bordered square and is colored in varying shades of yellow and gold, with darker areas to illustrate shading and contours, suggesting a metallic material. The candlestick has a wide, flat, square base that slopes upward with a beveled edge, narrowing at the neck and then widening again towards the cup where a candle would be placed. On the upper left side of the drawing, there are two additional line drawings: one is a simple, side silhouette of the candlestick, and the other is a top-down, square view, both rendered in black lines. Below these, there is a small measurement scale marked in inches from 0 to 3, also in black. The overall composition is clean, and the background is a plain, off-white color.
title: Candlestick
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
